description: This file is a shell script used for testing various git merge scenarios related to file mode changes, including setup, conflict detection, and verification of file permissions during merges.

methods.name: do_one_mode
methods.description: Function to test git merge strategies for a single mode change and verify the executable bit.

methods.name: do_both_modes
methods.description: Function to test detection of conflicts when both branches change file modes.

methods.name: do_delete_modechange
methods.description: Function to test detection of delete vs. mode change conflicts during merges.
